newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed, two wounded in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed, two wounded in Lebanon.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and two were wounded on Saturday when Hizbollah guerrillas attacked their post in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The guerrillas fired machineguns and anti-tank missiles at the Blat post in the western sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, hitting a tank, South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
"One of the Sagger missiles scored a direct hit, destroying a tank and killing one soldier and wounding two," one source said.
In retaliation, Israeli forces opened up with 120-mm and 155-mm artillery onto the outskirts of four villages just north of the western sector of the Israeli-held border strip.
There was no immediate word on any casualties in the retaliatory bombardment.

In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said in a statement that its guerrillas pounded the Blat post with anti-tank rockets and machinegun fire, destroying a Mirkava tank and "killing and wounding a number of soldiers".
Hizbollah, which is financed and armed by Tehran, leads an Islamic Resistance dedicated to ousting Israeli and SLA forces from the 15-km (nine-mile) deep zone.
Israel set up the zone extending from Mount Hermon in the east to the Mediterranean in 1985 to deter cross-border guerrilla raids on its northern settlements.
